title: dot-agents canonical lesson frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of dot-agents lesson files (.agents/lessons/<name>/LESSON.md for project-local or ~/.agents/lessons/<name>/LESSON.md for global). A lesson captures a corrective pattern, root cause, and actionable rule derived from a mistake or user correction. The body of the file is Markdown prose (not validated here); this schema covers only the frontmatter fields. The scope field is the canonical discriminator: 'global' maps to ~/.agents/lessons/ and applies to patterns that hold across all projects; 'project-local' maps to .agents/lessons/ and applies to patterns specific to one project or codebase. Note: many existing lesson files predate the frontmatter convention and have no frontmatter; this schema validates only those that carry a frontmatter block.

name.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; should match the lesson directory name under lessons/. Used for cross-references in index.md and workflow artifact notes.

scope.description: Optional but recommended routing discriminator (may be inferred from the lesson's directory when absent). 'global' = lesson lives under ~/.agents/lessons/ and captures a pattern that applies across all projects managed by dot-agents (e.g. general agent-behavior, cross-repo workflow patterns). 'project-local' = lesson lives under .agents/lessons/ and captures a pattern specific to one project's codebase or workflow (e.g. a project-specific Go import rule, project hook behavior, repo-specific CI gate mechanics).

description.description: One-line summary of the lesson pattern. Shown in the lessons index (index.md) and in worker bundle context blocks.

type.description: Category of lesson. Observed values: feedback (a corrective pattern from a user correction), process (a workflow or sequencing rule), lesson (a general learning). Open string — not enum-constrained to allow future categories.

tags.description: Optional keyword tags for KG indexing and relevance matching during Phase 1 lessons scan (see kg-ideate skill). Use lowercase kebab tokens.

superseded_by.description: Optional. Name of the lesson that supersedes this one. When set, consumers should load the referenced lesson instead. Use the kebab-case lesson name (directory name).
